transcript.text: Can you explain your responsibilities managing the daily cash book and supplier orders for about 35 items at your family grocery shop?

I come from Samastipur in Bihar and studied in Hindi medium till class twelve. I am finishing BCom at a government college. On weekends I keep the daily cash book at our family grocery and place supplier orders for about 35 items. My English is still improving, so I took a six-month spoken English course. I want an MBA because small shops like ours take loans at high rates, and I want to understand how banks and suppliers work with them.
How do you ensure the accuracy and timely updates when maintaining the daily cash book and managing supplier orders for your family shop?

feedback.summary: The candidate shows motivation to pursue an MBA to help small shopkeepers like their family in Bihar, which aligns well with their background and goals. However, they struggle to articulate concrete examples of their contributions and processes in managing the family shop's cash book and supplier orders. There is a lack of detail regarding their personal involvement and specific problem-solving abilities. The candidate also avoided addressing key questions and seemed uncomfortable discussing aspects linked to their educational background and role, leading to limited evidence on their practical skills and reasoning.
